content: Supabase RLS testing: tests live in supabase/tests/<table>_rls.test.sql and run via pgTAP (supabase test db). Impersonate roles with 'set local role' and 'set local request.jwt.claim.sub'; test per table, per command (SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE), per identity (owner, other user, other tenant, anon). Critical nuance: denied INSERT/DELETE raise errors but denied UPDATE/SELECT silently return zero rows, so never use lives_ok to prove an allowed write - assert row counts. RLS enabled with no policy = deny all.
